name: facts
title: Facts
description: Key/value list of an object's facts in a native <dl>: rows with a fixed term column (Sources, Service), an inline two-column grid (AgentTestRun, WorkflowRun), or columns of term-over-value (Workflow, Usage). Values can be mono, toned, or carry a muted sub line.

keyboard: Reaches links or buttons placed in a value
aria: Each term/value pair is wrapped in a div, which keeps valid <dl> content and the term-value association
In the inline layout the row is display: contents, so the grid does not change the reading order
A value tone (success, danger) is secondary: the words carry the meaning
a11y.notes: Static item: not focusable. Muted terms stay at 4.5:1 on the canvas, surface and bg backgrounds in both themes. values="secondary" (secondary values, muted tone in --text-muted) and lineHeight="relaxed" only change colours and spacing: --text-secondary and --text-muted keep 4.5:1 on those backgrounds.
